result:
Round 2 passes. I ran all nine acceptance checks myself, including a real UI save in the built Electron app. `realVerified` is true. I did not change any source file: the working tree still has the same 13 changed files, all in the ownership table, and nothing untracked.

- **R2-1 (the type check really checks files):** The node, web and test projects now check 9, 26 and 32 files. Each list includes the files the task requires.
- **R2-2 (no type errors):** `npm run typecheck` and each of the three projects alone pass with 0 errors, and `check` now calls `typecheck`.
- **R2-3 (the gate can fail):** In a `/tmp` copy, a deliberately wrong line in `src/main/index.ts`, `App.tsx` or `tests/renderer/setup.ts` makes the new check fail with TS2322 and exit 2. The old check command passes with the same broken line, so the original bug reproduces.
- **R2-4 (no test regressions):** From a clean state, the full verify command exits 0. Biome reports 0 errors, renderer tests pass 75/75, main tests 31/31 and E2E 6/6. A separate E2E run with no retries also passes 6/6.
- **R2-5 (the new keywords test can fail):** I broke `metadata.ts` in a `/tmp` copy in three different ways. Each time, only the new test failed. On the real tree it passes.
- **R2-6 (real app save):** Through the UI I set Title `C R2 Title`, Comment `C r2 comment` and Keywords `door, slam`, plus two artists and a genre, then clicked Save. music-metadata, ffprobe and a raw read of the file's info chunk all show the title and comment. ffprobe and the raw read show the keywords as `door, slam`. The audio data is byte-identical before and after. The file list showed the first artist and the genre right after saving and again after Rescan. Screenshots 01–05 are in the `c-round-2/` folder.
- **R2-7 (CI report):** The exact `check.yml` command exits 0, creates `playwright-report/index.html` and leaves no report server running. The YAML parses, and only the E2E step changed.
- **R2-8 (frozen files):** Frozen files are unchanged, and `package.json` changes only `check` and the new `typecheck`. There is no `any`, `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error`, `biome-ignore` or new code comment.
- **R2-9 (E2E rename):** Both specs only rename the page variable from `window` to `page`. Test names and assertions are unchanged.

**New finding C-R2-01 (low, already existed, not caused by A):** When there are two artists, they are written as two `ISTR` entries, not the `IART` the field list declares. ffprobe reports only the first one as `artist` and the second under a raw `ISTR` key, so an importer that reads `artist` would miss the second. B should decide this in the T-1 tag contract and give it a D-ID.

**Still open:**
- **TM-T0-CI:** It is listed under `blocked` as information only, not as a round-2 failure. It stays open until root links a green GitHub Actions run.
- **Windows:** The new `typecheck` script was only checked by reading it, because Windows isn't available here.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop/`:
- `c-round-2.md`
- `c-round-2.json`
- `c-round-2/`
